title: fix(app-shell): a locked metadata item's designer canvas is read-only
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8TMV42aHkwWJ3enBd3HQn32)_
Fixes #26888

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Setup 元数据编辑页对"不可写"的条目(被包锁定,或调用者无权编写)不再把 onPatch 交给设计器画布,画布随之只读。
- 为什么改:锁定对象的画布仍可加字段、移动/删除分区并显示"Unsaved",但页面没有保存按钮,离开即静默丢失。
- 风险与回滚:只改一个 prop;可写条目行为不变。回滚即还原该 prop,无数据或协议影响。
- 先看:ResourceEditPage.tsx 中预览组件的 onPatch 三元表达式;其次新测试文件 lockedCanvas-26888。
- 两分钟验证:pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.lockedCanvas-26888.test.tsx,预期 2 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`MetadataResourceEditPage` passes the registered designer preview `onPatch={readOnly ? undefined : …}` instead of an unconditional `onPatch`. `readOnly` is the page's existing `!canWrite && !createMode`, so it covers a locked item (`layered.editable === false`), a caller without `manage_metadata`, and a walled catalog. Per the preview contract (`MetadataPreviewProps.onPatch`), a canvas with no `onPatch` is read-only; `ObjectFormCanvas` derives `readOnly = !onPatch`, which hides Add field, Add section, Add field to this section, Move section up/down and Remove section. This mirrors Studio's read-only package handling (objectui#11136, `onPatch={readOnly ? undefined : onPatch}` in `StudioDesignSurface`). The fix is at the page, so every Setup designer type goes read-only on a locked item, not only Object; `ObjectPreview.tsx` needed no change.

The Description box (`ObjectDefaultInspector`) was already `disabled={readOnly}` through the page's `formReadOnly`: measured, already done.

## Tests

New `ResourceEditPage.lockedCanvas-26888.test.tsx` mounts the real page with the built-in designers registered:

- control: a writable object shows Add field, Add field to this section, Move section up/down, Remove section;
- a locked object (`editable: false`, `lock: 'full'`) shows the lock banner, none of those controls, and no "Unsaved".

Ablation (restore the unconditional `onPatch` via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit 1 → 0, blob 6cd1fb36 → 256b0123): the locked case goes red (the found Move/Remove BUTTON list did not deeply equal `[]`), control stays green; restore verified blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.
